<script>
    const root=document.documentElement;
    window.addEventListener('pointermove',ev=>{root.style.setProperty('--mx',`${(ev.clientX/innerWidth*100).toFixed(1)}%`);root.style.setProperty('--my',`${(ev.clientY/innerHeight*100).toFixed(1)}%`);},{passive:true});
    const topbar=document.getElementById('topbar');const toggle=document.querySelector('.menu-toggle');
    toggle?.addEventListener('click',()=>{const open=topbar.classList.toggle('open');toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(open));});
    topbar?.querySelectorAll('nav a').forEach(a=>a.addEventListener('click',()=>{topbar.classList.remove('open');toggle?.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');}));

    const reveal=[...document.querySelectorAll('.post,.note,.reveal')];
    const io=new IntersectionObserver(entries=>{entries.forEach(entry=>{if(entry.isIntersecting)entry.target.classList.add('visible');});},{threshold:.12});
    reveal.forEach(el=>io.observe(el));

    let ticking=false;
    function updateScroll(){ticking=false;const vh=innerHeight||1;document.querySelectorAll('.feature-image').forEach(card=>{const r=card.getBoundingClientRect();const p=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(vh-r.top)/(vh+r.height)));card.style.setProperty('--imgY',`${(p-.5)*-28}px`);card.style.setProperty('--shineX',`${-110+p*220}%`);});}
    addEventListener('scroll',()=>{if(!ticking){ticking=true;requestAnimationFrame(updateScroll);}}, {passive:true});updateScroll();

    const filters=[...document.querySelectorAll('.filter')];const posts=[...document.querySelectorAll('.post')];
    const loadMore=document.getElementById('loadMore');const loadPanel=document.getElementById('loadPanel');const loadStatus=document.getElementById('loadStatus');
    let activeFilter='all';let visibleLimit=6;const pageSize=6;
    function matchingPosts(){return posts.filter(post=>activeFilter==='all'||post.dataset.category===activeFilter);}
    function layoutSpans(count){if(count<=0)return[];if(count===1)return[12];if(count===2)return[6,6];if(count===4)return[6,6,6,6];if(count===5)return[6,6,4,4,4];return Array.from({length:count},()=>4);}
    function applyPostState(){const matches=matchingPosts();posts.forEach(post=>{post.classList.toggle('hidden',!(activeFilter==='all'||post.dataset.category===activeFilter));post.classList.remove('not-loaded');post.style.gridColumn='';});matches.forEach((post,index)=>post.classList.toggle('not-loaded',index>=visibleLimit));const visible=matches.slice(0,visibleLimit);if(innerWidth>760){const spans=layoutSpans(visible.length);visible.forEach((post,index)=>{post.style.gridColumn='span '+spans[index];});}const total=matches.length;const shown=Math.min(visibleLimit,total);if(loadPanel&&loadStatus&&loadMore){loadStatus.textContent=`${shown} von ${total} Beiträgen sichtbar`;loadPanel.hidden=total<=pageSize;loadMore.hidden=shown>=total;}}
    filters.forEach(btn=>btn.addEventListener('click',()=>{activeFilter=btn.dataset.filter||'all';visibleLimit=pageSize;filters.forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('active',b===btn));applyPostState();}));
    loadMore?.addEventListener('click',()=>{visibleLimit+=pageSize;applyPostState();});
    addEventListener('resize',applyPostState,{passive:true});applyPostState();

  </script>

  <script>
    (() => {
      const header = document.querySelector('.topbar, .top');
      if (!header) return;
      const parseColor = (value) => {
        if (!value) return null;
        const match = value.match(/rgba?\(([^)]+)\)/i);
        if (!match) return null;
        const parts = match[1].trim().split(/[\s,\/]+/).filter(Boolean).map(Number);
        if (parts.length < 3 || parts.slice(0, 3).some(Number.isNaN)) return null;
        return { r: parts[0], g: parts[1], b: parts[2], a: Number.isFinite(parts[3]) ? parts[3] : 1 };
      };
      const luma = ({ r, g, b }) => (0.2126 * r + 0.7152 * g + 0.0722 * b) / 255;
      const themeFromStyle = (el) => {
        const style = getComputedStyle(el);
        const solid = parseColor(style.backgroundColor);
        if (solid && solid.a > 0.45) return luma(solid) > 0.62 ? 'light' : 'dark';
        const colors = style.backgroundImage.match(/rgba?\([^)]+\)/gi) || [];
        for (const color of colors) {
          const parsed = parseColor(color);
          if (parsed && parsed.a > 0.45) return luma(parsed) > 0.62 ? 'light' : 'dark';
        }
        return null;
      };
      const themeForPoint = (x, y) => {
        const stack = document.elementsFromPoint(x, y).filter((el) => !header.contains(el));
        for (const el of stack) {
          const marker = el.closest?.('[data-header-theme]');
          if (marker) return marker.dataset.headerTheme;
        }
        for (const el of stack) {
          let node = el;
          while (node && node !== document.documentElement) {
            if (!header.contains(node)) {
              const theme = themeFromStyle(node);
              if (theme) return theme;
            }
            node = node.parentElement;
          }
        }
        return 'dark';
      };
      let ticking = false;
      const updateHeaderTheme = () => {
        ticking = false;
        const rect = header.getBoundingClientRect();
        const y = Math.max(8, Math.min(innerHeight - 8, rect.top + Math.min(34, Math.max(18, rect.height * .42))));
        const points = [
          [Math.min(innerWidth - 8, Math.max(8, rect.left + rect.width / 2)), y],
          [Math.min(innerWidth - 8, Math.max(8, rect.left + 42)), y],
          [Math.min(innerWidth - 8, Math.max(8, rect.right - 42)), y]
        ];
        let lightVotes = 0;
        let total = 0;
        points.forEach(([xPoint, yPoint]) => {
          const theme = themeForPoint(xPoint, yPoint);
          if (theme) {
            total += 1;
            if (theme === 'light') lightVotes += 1;
          }
        });
        const onLight = total > 0 && lightVotes >= Math.ceil(total / 2);
        header.classList.toggle('header-on-light', onLight);
        header.classList.toggle('header-on-dark', !onLight);
      };
      const queueHeaderTheme = () => {
        if (!ticking) {
          ticking = true;
          requestAnimationFrame(updateHeaderTheme);
        }
      };
      addEventListener('scroll', queueHeaderTheme, { passive: true });
      addEventListener('resize', queueHeaderTheme, { passive: true });
      updateHeaderTheme();
    })();
  </script>
<script src="/assets/site-chrome.js" defer></script>
